entities.summary: Orlando Lamon Robinson Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Memphis Hustle of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for Fresno State. Robinson has played for the Miami Heat, Sacramento Kings, Toronto Raptors and Orlando Magic in his NBA tenure.
